thread:
marta: Heads-up — weird onboarding fail today. Sample-app showed an empty tool output. Traced it to the node SDK: after an auth retry the streaming tool_call args arrived as a string with trailing whitespace and a null byte, so the schema helper returned {} and UI rendered a blank card.

sam: Yikes. Is this another double-encode case or something else?

marta: Related, but marginally different. The replayed chunks appear to have padding from our cache buffer which left a \u0000 at the end. Logged payload after retry: `{"tool_call":{"name":"get_meta","args":"{\"id\":\"x1\"}\u0000 `}` — parse fails.

ben: That explains it. Our previous JSON.parse fallback doesn't trim control chars. Node transport needs a tiny canonicalizer.

sam: Quick mitigation: land a helper guard that strips nulls and trims before JSON.parse. But long-term we should enforce a transport-level guarantee: structured fields must be objects when helpers run.

marta: I pushed a tiny helper patch that does `if (typeof args==='string') args = args.replace(/\u0000/g,'').trim(); try { args = JSON.parse(args) } catch(e) { /* leave as-is */ }`. Fixes demo.

olga: Parity note: python SDK already normalizes at transport so we never hit this in py. We should add a cross-SDK behavior doc and tests.

sam: Proposal for node SDK: implement a fast-path normalizer in the transport boundary that (1) strips control chars, (2) trims, (3) attempts JSON.parse. If parse fails, emit debug telemetry and skip expensive fallbacks. Expose this behavior under config `strictStructuredParsing: true` by default so onboarding has good DX but teams can opt-out. Thoughts?

ben: Works for me. Keep slow fallbacks (single->double quotes) out of hot path — only try them when debug flag enabled so we're not masking replay bugs.

marta: Also add telemetry event `structured_parse_normalized: true` so we can count how often SDK is fixing payloads. That will help prioritize fixing the replay cache.

sam: Action list: (1) short-term helper guard stays (marta) — landed small PR with unit tests; (2) node transport fast normalizer spike (sam) — will include stripping \u0000 and trim + parse; (3) sample-app integration test that simulates 401 then replay with padded chunk (ben) — to be added to sample-app CI and marked flaky until fix; (4) add cross-SDK parity test and README note (olga).

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-1402: "transport: node fast normalizer for structured tool fields + telemetry" and linked sample-app trace.

olga: Once node normalizer lands, we'll remove the helper's heavier heuristics and document the guarantee: "SDK guarantees parsed objects for tool_call.args in structured/jsonMode when strictStructuredParsing is enabled." Add a short snippet to onboarding docs.

marta: One gotcha: streaming parser lifecycle differs; normalizer must operate at chunk-assembly boundary, not after final parse. Make sure tests cover chunked inputs with trailing control bytes.

sam: Good call. I'll instrument chunk reassembly and add telemetry when normalization happens in streaming path. Keep the fast path cheap.

ben: I'll add the integration harness today. It will inject a 401 on first chunk and replay a chunk with `\u0000` and extra spaces on retry to reproduce.

marta: TL;DR: blank onboarding output traced to padded/replayed chunk with control chars after auth retry in node streaming path. Temp helper guard landed; transport fast normalizer + telemetry + cross-SDK tests in flight. Ping me for PR review.

sam: Nice triage. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: DEVEX-1402 status: open -> in progress.
